subject.title: fix(canvas): bound A2UI JSONL file reads

question: Should `GatewayClient` enforce the negotiated `hello-ok.policy.maxPayload` for every outgoing request, rather than limiting this protection only to Canvas A2UI uploads?
rationale: The PR’s Canvas fix depends on a shared transport-contract change that affects every Gateway client caller; code inspection supports the design, but maintainers must confirm that the Gateway policy is intended as a universal client-side preflight contract.

options.title: Adopt shared enforcement
options.body: Keep the shared serialized-frame guard, resolve conflicts, and refresh exact-head protocol and Canvas proof.

options.title: Limit enforcement to Canvas
options.body: Move the encoded-size preflight into the Canvas upload path if maintainers consider the negotiated policy server-enforcement-only for other clients.

options.title: Pause for protocol contract clarification
options.body: Hold the PR if the meaning and lifecycle of `policy.maxPayload` is not an intended stable client contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared enforcement
recommendation.body: Keep the shared serialized-frame guard, resolve conflicts, and refresh exact-head protocol and Canvas proof.

likelyOwner.reason: RileyJJY is the named human reviewer in the supplied timeline for this shared Gateway/Canvas change.
